source_locator: p. 233, The Freer Gospels, first paragraph
source_text: which dates perhaps to the seventh or eighth century.
attribution: J. Bruce Prior, Who Is Full of Grace and Truth in the Ws Text of John 1:14?, Bulletin for Biblical Research 11.2 (2001), p. 233, public article opening reproduced by Galaxie.
scope_paraphrase: Prior identifies the lost opening John quire as replaced by eight later leaves covering John 1:1 through 5:11a; Ws, Wsup, and Wsupp are labels of that quire, not additional physical codices.
numeric_conversion: One qualified source interval covering both whole centuries: 601-800 CE inclusive. The word perhaps is retained. No preferred scholar, numerical probability, or current consensus is asserted.
